---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement
---

## User problem

What are you trying to do, and where does the current app get in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change. Alternatives are welcome.

## API support

Link the relevant official Capy documentation or operation if this needs API access. If support is unknown, say so. Check Docs/LIMITATIONS.md before proposing a capability.

## Contribution

Optional: are you interested in implementing or testing it?
